notes: Two-site tillage trial (Goma, Kimenyedde; Mukono District, Uganda), 3 seasons Apr 2019-Jun 2020, CRD with 2 replicates per site, common bean NABE 4, no fertiliser. Only cost_return was extracted this round; adoption and carbon were not extracted this round (left empty). Table 3 (p8) is the only economic data: one value per treatment pooled over both sites and the 14 months; no per-site or per-season economics are printed. Rows: NT vs CT (ca_bundle) and SM vs CT (practice=other: residue/mulch cover with conventional ploughing, not CA). DT (deep tillage to 40 cm, bare soil) vs CT not extracted: the contrast is deeper tillage, not a vocabulary practice. NT vs DT and NT vs SM not extracted as rows: CT is the paper's conventional control, and the text gives only multiples (net profit 3x CT, 5x DT; DT gross cost 2x NT, 1.5x CT), no new values. study_design: the paper says 'experimental sites' and does not say on-station or on-farm (plots previously maize then 2 years fallow); recorded experiment_on_station, to check. Minor paper inconsistency, not affecting values: Section 2.7 says yields for the economics are from the 30 m x 5 m plots, Section 2.5 says yield was measured on a 1 m x 1 m plot in each treatment plot.

cost_return.outcome_formula: land rent, tillage, machinery, seeds, mulches, herbicide, insecticide, labor, harvesting, etc. (Section 2.7)
cost_return.treatment_name: No-tillage (NT): no soil disturbance, seeds planted in disk-opener slots, surface covered with crop residues and mulches (8 Mg/ha), glyphosate weed control
cost_return.control_name: Conventional tillage (CT): ploughing to 0-15 cm (tractor-drawn Huard plough), no soil covering, hand-hoe weeding
cost_return.site: Goma and Kimenyedde experimental sites, Mukono District
cost_return.locator: Table 3, row "NT" (treatment) and row "CT" (control), column "Gross cost (USD ha1)"
cost_return.note: NT vs CT is a full CA contrast (no tillage + residue/mulch cover against ploughed bare soil); NT also swaps hand-hoe weeding for herbicide, recorded in other_practices. Table 3 gives one value per treatment for the whole 14 months (three seasons, April 2019-June 2020: 2019 1st season, 2019 2nd season, 2020 season, Figure 3) and both sites (Goma, Kimenyedde) together; the paper does not say whether seasons were summed or averaged, nor whether sites were pooled or averaged. Control = CT, the paper's conventional practice; the paper itself compares NT and SM with CT (abstract, Sections 3.6, 4.5). Superscript letters (Tukey, p = 0.05) are significance groups, not errors; no spread printed. Exchange rate not printed (only the bean price, Ugshs.3800 = USD1.03/kg); left empty. Replicates: 2 per site at each of 2 sites (CRD, 30 m x 5 m plots). Cost items from the Section 2.7 list, which ends in 'etc.': tax, transport, interest marked No as not listed; nutrient_inputs NA (no fertiliser applied); irrigation NA (rainfed); mulches, harvesting and tillage in other_costs. labour_valued unstated: labour is costed but the paper does not say whose labour or how it was valued. Prices: observed market selling price at harvest, measured yields, so field_measured. [fix 2026-11-17: glyphosate removed from other_practices: part of how no-till works (2022 practice); its cost is under pest_control_inputs]
